name: Editor modes and an Add menu

questions.text: Which modes? Recommended: Select, Terrain, Graph, Silhouette, with Add in Select mode and Graph and Silhouette tied to their tabs. Alternatives: a separate Place mode, or only Level and Terrain.
questions.answer: Dean (2026-11-26): two modes, Select (with the Add menu for shapes, lights, Silhouettes and the rest) and Terrain. A Silhouette and its graph are tabs, not modes; while their tab is up the level's menus and panels hide.
